The design was read 1503 commits before the note's base, so re-measure its premises (cloud_relay.sh, orchestrator_tick.py, tick_loop.sh, state_docs.py, roster_lib.py, roster_sync.py, plan_page.py all moved) before building. Scope: (1) An obligations ledger replacing the relay's log scan and the tick's OWED scan: keyed by kind, subject and sha; a disposal written by the producer; a moved subject closes the old entry and opens one; an unclassifiable ref is a refusal; an obligation with no ledger kind is a refusal; a missing store is a first run and an unreadable one prints UNREADABLE, never a clean board. Its import must classify the three prefixes the relay actually writes (probe, handoff, handoff-body) and take the last disposition per ref. Corrections from the round-3 review that bind the implementation: the folded approve-held-runs and dispatch reasons have no backing state in the relay's failure file today, so either that file's format gains a reason field or they become their own derived kinds; an instrument is wired in the same pull request that lands it, and the reason is that pr-contract makes the body answer a red on the wiring check (not that the check is required); and the two remaining figure corrections in the review's round-3 findings are carried into whatever the body states. Ledger extension owed (round-10 orphaned-handoff RCA, accepted 2026-10-20; the record lands under dev/audit/rca/): the obligations ledger's handoff-no-pr kind carries an age -- at 24 h a stranded handoff becomes a DISPATCH line naming its group and opener, oldest first; at 48 h it raises an owner flag. It records an opener attempt (the 11:50Z openers ended Terminated: 15 with no retry), closes a ref whose change main already carries by content rather than only by ancestry, and adds the design-to-build dispatch as its own kind: an approved design ref owes a build dispatch, not a pull request. The aging thresholds are policy and belong to tvofi: build the mechanics behind a switch and leave the defaults for approval. An unreadable store prints UNREADABLE, never a clean board and never a silent finding. Landing order: A, then R10-ORCH-DISPATCH-REG, then R10-ORCH-BEATD, then R10-ORCH-PLANPAGE.
